input.prompt: Same board as the third reference, same painting, but the frame is a very wide thin strip of it: one long straight horizontal light-guide channel, recessed, edged with thin polished gold rails, filled with clear dark resin, unlit, its height only one twelfth of the frame height, running the full width exactly through the vertical centre. Above and below it, bundles of fine parallel gold copper traces run horizontally the full width, tightly packed, with small vias and a few tiny SMD resistors. Faint red rim light at the left edge, faint green rim light at the right edge, one warm key light from above. No text, no letters, no numbers, no logos, no chips.
